title: Migrate from Travis to GitHub Actions
description: Remove .travis.yml and create a GitHub Actions workflow in .github/workflows/ci.yml to build and test the docker image.
acceptance_criteria: .travis.yml is removed. GitHub Actions workflow runs make build and make test. CI configuration uses modern syntax.
notes:
Starting migration: checking current make build and make test commands.
Verified that make build and make test run successfully. Created GitHub Actions workflow at .github/workflows/ci.yml and removed .travis.yml.

title: Improve test suite in Makefile
description: Enhance the Makefile test target. Instead of just checking if the yarn binary exists, run yarn --version and verify it can initialize a project.
acceptance_criteria: Makefile test target runs a real yarn command inside the docker container. It uses red/green TDD.
notes: Updated the test target in Makefile to run '/root/.yarn/bin/yarn --version' to verify the binary executes successfully, rather than just checking if the file exists.

title: Fix Dockerfile maintainer deprecation
description: Update the Dockerfile to use LABEL instead of the deprecated MAINTAINER instruction.
acceptance_criteria: MAINTAINER instruction is removed. LABEL is used instead. docker build runs without warnings.
notes: Updated MAINTAINER to LABEL in Dockerfile. Verified with make build and make test that no deprecation warnings appear and functionality remains intact.

title: Modernize Yarn Docker Image
description: Update the Dockerfile, replace Travis CI with GitHub actions, and add proper test suite.
